description: Frozen eval set for autoresearch sessions. Each entry replays one historical cycle. Picked to span time-of-day, news-day variety, and recency (within 30 days so trends snapshots are still meaningful). Add or swap entries between sessions; freeze for the duration of a session so iteration deltas are comparable.

cycles.notes: Politics-heavy late cycle — good test of selector under regional-balance pressure
Economy-tech mix, evening cycle — exercises trends pickup and shape-specific blocks
Early-cycle balanced day — good baseline for voice and brevity scoring
